last_assistant_message:
Diffs are clean and minimal, purely structural. The `boot/` and `morning-briefing` state.yaml changes plus the untracked `workflows/boot/verify/` are pre-existing from other work (the verifier scripts mentioned in the task background) and were not touched by me.

Summary:

**golf-booking/state.yaml** — fixed. The free-form narrative block (lines 14-49) that broke the parser had no YAML key; it directly followed `resolution-note: null`, so I converted it into a literal block scalar (`resolution-note: |`) preserving all the original text verbatim (execution summary, blockers, root cause, resolution options, action log). Verified with plain `yaml.safe_load()` — parses cleanly, all 14 top-level keys intact including `accumulated-context`.

**Trailing `---` issue** — audited all 54 `workflows/*/state.yaml` files. 39 had a stray trailing `---` creating a bogus empty second document; removed the trailing marker (and any trailing blank lines) from each:

account-pursuit-map, account-strategy, audience-target-outreach, calendar-prep, card-review, card-walkthrough, card-which, comp-tracker, content-calendar, delegation-tracker, email-drafting, episode-campaign-brief, evolution-deployment, evolution-training-sync, follow-up-nudges, galen-monthly-health-review, goal-alignment, inbox-processing, initiative-tracker, knowledge-ingest, lead-log, lead-review, leadership-prep, one-on-one-prep, partner-meeting-prep, pipeline-review, podcast-prep, presentation-builder, rock-review, rock1-revenue-monthly, rock4-pipeline-weekly, shutdown-cleanup, talking-points, training-module-runner, training-onboarding, training-status, weekly-knowledge-review, weekly-review, win-loss-analysis.

**One additional genuine multi-document file found**: `content-pipeline/state.yaml` had a leading `---`, a full first document, a middle `---` separator, and a second non-empty document (`current-step: null`) — not the empty-trailing-doc pattern. I merged both documents' keys into one single mapping (no key collisions existed) and removed both `---` markers.

**Untouched**: 14 files were already valid single-document YAML — left alone.

**Final verification**: ran `yaml.safe_load()` (plain, no `_all`) against all 54 `workflows/*/state.yaml` files — all 54 now parse successfully with zero errors. No state values (status, timestamps, IDs, etc.) were altered anywhere, only YAML structure/syntax.

Files touched (all under `/Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/workflows/`): the 39 listed above, plus `golf-booking/state.yaml` and `content-pipeline/state.yaml` — 41 files total.
